en: Rotate through wallets to buy, sell, or alternate. Set the interval and total number of trades.
zh_Hans: 按钱包轮流买入、卖出或交替买卖，可填交易间隔和总笔数。

en: For 2 wallets and 4 alternating trades, wallet A buys and sells, then wallet B buys and sells.
zh_Hans: 两个钱包交替买卖，共四笔：A 买、A 卖、B 买、B 卖。

en: Check the contract address carefully; tokens can be imitated.
zh_Hans: 请核对合约地址，注意分辨代币真伪。

en: Add an address group to start.
zh_Hans: 添加地址组后开始配置。

en: Keys of this group are removed from the module. Make sure they are backed up.
zh_Hans: 本组私钥将从模块中移除，请确认已自行备份。

en: Based on the balance when the group starts
Checking a sell submits any missing token approvals and uses network gas. You confirm the sale separately.
zh_Hans: 检查卖出时会先补授权并支付网络费，卖出金额另行确认。

en: Stop sends nothing new; submitted transactions keep confirming.
zh_Hans: 停止后不再发送新交易，已提交的交易继续确认

en: kept in memory for this session only
zh_Hans: 仅保存在本次会话内存中

en: Complete keys are held in this session and backed up in plain text when a local folder is connected. This includes keys from canceled edits.
zh_Hans: 完整私钥会暂存在本次会话，连接本地文件夹后自动明文备份。取消编辑也会保留备份。

en: This group will be removed from the generated list. Its backed-up private keys will be kept.
zh_Hans: 将从生成列表移除这组钱包，已备份的私钥会保留。
已复制，请妥善保存私钥

en: New wallets can receive funds only after their keys are copied and saved.
zh_Hans: 新钱包须先复制保存私钥，才能接收资金。

en: Connect a local folder and let the key backup finish before using new wallets to receive funds.
zh_Hans: 新钱包收款前，请先连接本地文件夹，并等待私钥写入完成。

en: Connect a local folder and let the relay key backup finish before starting.
zh_Hans: 中转地址会接收资金。请先连接本地文件夹，并等待中转私钥写入完成。

en: Fill in the source private key
One set of wallets buys or sells together
zh_Hans: 一组钱包统一买入或卖出

en: Sellers sell first; buyers buy back with the BNB received
zh_Hans: 先卖后买：卖方卖出，买方用实际到账 BNB 买回

en: Based on the sellers' total holdings at start
zh_Hans: 按卖方启动时总持仓计算

en: When buyers lack BNB, their relay wallets top them up from the sellers.
zh_Hans: 买方余额不足时，经中转补款。

en: Relays receive funds: copy and keep their keys before starting.
zh_Hans: 中转地址会接收资金，开始前请先复制保存中转私钥。

en: Confirmed trades stay; the remaining buy-back will not run.
zh_Hans: 已成交交易不会撤销，剩余买回不再执行。

en: Some transactions have no final status yet. Nothing new is sent and nothing is resent until they are queried.
zh_Hans: 有交易尚未确认：查询前不会发送新交易，也不会重复发送。

en: Sell order submitted. Three reconciliation retries failed. Automatic checks of the original transaction will continue.
zh_Hans: 卖单已提交，连续 3 次重试仍未完成对账。系统会继续自动核对原交易。

en: Buy order submitted. Three reconciliation retries failed. Automatic checks of the original transaction will continue.
zh_Hans: 买单已提交，连续 3 次重试仍未完成对账。系统会继续自动核对原交易。

en: Only the remaining wallets of this round continue; later rounds use the original settings.
zh_Hans: 仅继续本轮剩余钱包；下一轮仍按原设置。

en: Private keys will be copied to the clipboard. Keep them safe.
zh_Hans: 私钥将复制到剪贴板，请妥善保存。

en: Enter seller and buyer keys first
zh_Hans: 请先输入卖方和买方私钥

en: Select wallets and choose buy or sell. Send their trades in a bundle or one at a time at set intervals.
zh_Hans: 导入一组钱包，勾选后统一买入或卖出，可捆绑发送或按间隔逐笔发送。

en: Each selected wallet aims to sell 1,000 tokens and keeps the BNB it receives.
zh_Hans: 每个勾选的钱包各计划卖出 1,000 枚，所得 BNB 留在各自钱包。

en: Import sellers and buyers separately. Each round, sellers sell first. Buyers buy back the same token with the BNB received. Relay wallets top up buyers if needed.
zh_Hans: 分别导入卖方和买方。每轮先卖，再按实际到账的 BNB 买回同一种币。买方余额不足时，经中转钱包补款。

en: All sellers together sell 1,000 tokens. If they receive 0.2 BNB, buyers use that budget to buy back tokens into their own wallets.
zh_Hans: 所有卖方合计卖出 1,000 枚。若实收 0.2 BNB，买方就以 0.2 BNB 为预算买回，代币进入买方钱包。

en: Amounts were drawn once. Check the wallet count, asset and direction before confirming.
zh_Hans: 金额已抽取并锁定，请核对钱包数、代币和买卖方向。

en: The first round runs as shown; later rounds draw again with the same settings.
zh_Hans: 首轮按以上金额执行，之后每轮按同样设置重新抽取。

en: Paired in order; counts must match.
zh_Hans: 按顺序一一对应，数量须相同。

en: Same min and max = equal amounts. Amounts are drawn once on Use and not redrawn at submission.
zh_Hans: 两值相同即等量分发；使用后生成明细，提交时不再随机。

en: 100% sends the whole available balance; gas is kept back. Amounts are fixed once drawn.
zh_Hans: 100% 转出全部可用余额，网络费另留；使用后生成明细，金额固定。

en: Numbers match the recipients; the distributor pays both legs of gas.
zh_Hans: 编号对应接收地址；由分发方支付两段网络费。

en: Amounts are fixed. Sent transfers cannot be withdrawn; unconfirmed ones are queried, never resent.
zh_Hans: 金额已固定；已发送的转账不可撤回，未确认的只查询，不重复发送。

en: Tap Use to draw the amounts first
zh_Hans: 请先点“使用”生成分发明细

en: Image selection is not available in this host
zh_Hans: 当前宿主未提供图片选择
每个捆绑的构建者小费

en: Sell all holdings in the launch and subsequent group-trade wallets shown here. Each sale uses the minimum {asset} amount in that wallet’s sale quote.
zh_Hans: 含本轮发币和后续批量买卖中仍有持仓的钱包。每个钱包的最低到账 {asset} 数量由其卖出报价确定。
内盘地址加入开盘免税
底池币地址（留空为 BNB）

en: Four.meme's official service cannot be reached from our server right now, so launching on Four waits until it answers again. Buying and selling existing Four.meme tokens is not affected and works as usual in Batch trade.
zh_Hans: Four.meme 官方接口暂时无法从我们的服务器访问，恢复后即可发币。已发行的 Four 代币买卖不受影响，可在批量买卖中正常操作。
最大单笔预计价格影响

en: V4 price impact cannot be assessed. Check the pool liquidity.
zh_Hans: 根据V4交易的特点，暂无法评估价格冲击，请主动核查流动性

en: The current route has no reliable impact estimate.
zh_Hans: 当前路径暂无可靠的价格影响数据。
请核对流动性后决定是否继续。
捆绑及清仓 · 整组提醒

en: Interval start · highest wallet impact alert
zh_Hans: 间隔启动 · 各钱包最大值提醒
间隔执行 · 单笔暂停

en: This estimate covers the displayed leg. Buy-back depends on actual proceeds. Each later bundle is checked before submission and pauses if it exceeds the alert.
zh_Hans: 此处预估当前这笔捆绑。买回金额按卖出实收计算，后续每批发送前核对整组影响，超限即暂停。

en: Balances and allowances follow confirmed transactions. Refresh after using these wallets elsewhere.
zh_Hans: 余额与授权按已确认交易更新。钱包在其他地方操作后，请刷新。
钱包余额与授权已刷新

en: Still checking. You can stop the next steps. Submitted approvals will continue to confirm.
zh_Hans: 仍在检查，可停止后续操作。已提交的授权会继续确认。

en: The preview has expired. Prepare again using the current settings.
zh_Hans: 准备结果已失效，请按当前设置重新准备。
钱包正在其他操作中使用

en: Finish the listed operation or check its pending transactions before using these wallets.
zh_Hans: 请先完成列出的操作，或查清原交易结果，再使用以下钱包。
